instruction: Why is my Lambda function {{troubleshooting-multiservice-lambda-1sscp39dx-us-west-2-LambdaFunctionName}} in us-west-2 not reading the updated AppConfig value? I deployed a new configuration but the function still gets the old value.
expected_answer: The Lambda function {{troubleshooting-multiservice-lambda-1sscp39dx-us-west-2-LambdaFunctionName}} is not reading the updated AppConfig value because its environment variables APP_CONFIG_APPLICATION, APP_CONFIG_ENVIRONMENT, and APP_CONFIG_CONFIGURATION are set to CloudFormation logical IDs (GRNCMSAppConfigApplication537888D7, GRNCMSAppConfigEnvironment9802B737, GRNCMSAppConfigConfigurationConfigurationProfile7AB3584E) instead of the actual resource names (GarnetAppConfig, beta, GarnetServicebeta-GRNCMSAppConfigConfiguration-EE839D38). Any call to the AppConfig API using these logical IDs will fail with a ResourceNotFoundException. To fix this, update the three environment variables to the actual resource names. Additionally, the function has no AWS AppConfig Lambda extension layer attached. While the current code uses the SDK directly and would work once the env vars are corrected, adding the extension layer is a best practice for caching and reducing API calls. The AppConfig deployment itself completed successfully with application ID {{troubleshooting-multiservice-lambda-1sscp39dx-us-west-2-AppConfigApplicationId}}, environment ID {{troubleshooting-multiservice-lambda-1sscp39dx-us-west-2-AppConfigEnvironmentId}}, and configuration profile ID {{troubleshooting-multiservice-lambda-1sscp39dx-us-west-2-AppConfigConfigurationProfileId}}, and the Lambda execution role has the correct AppConfig permissions.
